summary: Adjacent face values to cell-center midpoints on a one-dimensional grid.

identity.definition: Adjacent arithmetic midpoint; output has one fewer entry and same units. Sum first when representable, otherwise sum halved endpoints; no invented geometry or coordinate fallback.
identity.model: Midpoint-averaging relation with explicit SciRel numeric boundary checks
identity.coordinates: face index order; no coordinate values consumed
identity.boundary: finite real one-dimensional face vector with at least two entries
assumptions: No extrapolation or broadcast axis is inferred.
The relation carries values only; geometry coordinates remain caller-owned.

inputs.name: face
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric one-dimensional array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite numeric one-dimensional array, n>=2; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

outputs.name: cell
outputs.constraints: finite; one fewer entry than face

preconditions: finite real one-dimensional face vector with at least two entries
supported: Finite one-dimensional midpoint interpolation with at least two face values; no broadcasting.
excluded: Whole-transport evolution, experimental calibration, and implicit coordinate reconstruction.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for boolean/string/complex/masked or empty input, non-finite values, malformed or incompatible shape; no invented singular domain is accepted.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError if an accepted midpoint unexpectedly becomes nonfinite; finite float64 endpoint midpoints are representable.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a direct algebraic mapping.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No output is returned after an exception.

example.description: Convert four face coordinates to the three adjacent cell-center coordinates.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry import face_to_cell
np.testing.assert_array_equal(face_to_cell([0.,2.,8.,10.]), [1.,5.,9.])
example.expected: The returned float64 cell centers are [1.0, 5.0, 9.0].

scope: Manufactured midpoint values, subnormal rounding, finite endpoint overflow avoidance, shape and dtype boundary.
Declared failure cases for empty, boolean/string/complex/masked, nonfinite and incompatible inputs.
Agreement with the canonical SciRel callers and dependencies of this relation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the named relation, shape and selected boundary behavior only; they do not establish global physical calibration.
known_limitations: No nonuniform coordinate interpolation is provided.
Agreement is bounded to the midpoint relation; SciRel adds explicit input checks.
